cantrips.name: Dancing Lights
cantrips.description: Create up to four torch-sized lights (or combine them into one dim humanoid shape) that hover in the air and that you can move as a bonus action.

cantrips.name: Light
cantrips.description: Touch an object no larger than 10 feet in any dimension, causing it to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for 20 feet more, for up to an hour.

cantrips.name: Mage Hand
cantrips.description: Create a spectral floating hand within range that you can use to manipulate objects, open unlocked doors or containers, or move small items at a distance.

cantrips.name: Mending
cantrips.description: Repair a single break or tear in an object you touch, as long as the damaged area is no larger than a foot across, leaving no trace of the former damage.

cantrips.name: Message
cantrips.description: Whisper a message toward a creature within range; only that creature hears it and can whisper a reply back that only you hear.

cantrips.name: Minor Illusion
cantrips.description: Create a sound or the image of an object within range that lasts up to a minute; physically interacting with the image, or examining it closely, can reveal it as an illusion.

cantrips.name: Prestidigitation
cantrips.description: Create one of several minor magical effects at will: a harmless sensory trick, lighting or snuffing a small flame, cleaning or soiling a small object, briefly flavoring or marking something, or conjuring a small nonmagical trinket.

cantrips.name: True Strike
cantrips.description: Point at a target and briefly read its defenses; on your next turn you gain advantage on your first attack roll against that target, provided the spell hasn't ended.

cantrips.name: Vicious Mockery
cantrips.description: Hurl a string of insults laced with subtle magic at a creature that can hear you; it makes a Wisdom save or takes 1d4 psychic damage and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.

cantrips.name: Guidance
cantrips.description: Touch a willing creature; once before the spell ends, it can add 1d4 to one ability check of its choice.

cantrips.name: Sacred Flame
cantrips.description: Call down flame-like radiance on a creature you can see; it makes a Dexterity save, with no benefit from cover, or takes 1d8 radiant damage.

cantrips.name: Spare the Dying
cantrips.description: Touch a living creature that has 0 hit points, causing it to become stable.

cantrips.name: Thaumaturgy
cantrips.description: Manifest a minor supernatural sign at will: a booming voice, flickering flames, harmless ground tremors, a remote sound, a door flying open or slamming shut, or briefly altered eyes.

cantrips.name: Druidcraft
cantrips.description: Produce a small nature effect: predict the next 24 hours of weather at your location, make a plant bud or bloom, create a harmless sensory effect, or light or snuff out a small flame.

cantrips.name: Poison Spray
cantrips.description: Project a puff of noxious gas at a creature within 10 feet; it makes a Constitution save or takes 1d12 poison damage, increasing at higher character levels.

cantrips.name: Produce Flame
cantrips.description: Conjure a harmless flickering flame in your hand that sheds light for up to 10 minutes, or hurl it at a creature within 30 feet as a ranged spell attack for 1d8 fire damage, ending the spell.

cantrips.name: Shillelagh
cantrips.description: Imbue a club or quarterstaff you're holding with nature's power, letting you use your spellcasting ability instead of Strength for its attack and damage rolls, and increasing its damage die to a d8.

cantrips.name: Acid Splash
cantrips.description: Hurl a bubble of acid at one creature, or two creatures standing within 5 feet of each other; each target makes a Dexterity save or takes 1d6 acid damage, increasing at higher character levels.

cantrips.name: Chill Touch
cantrips.description: Make a ranged spell attack with a ghostly skeletal hand; on a hit the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage and can't regain hit points until your next turn, and an undead target also has disadvantage on attacks against you.
